file_roles.evidence: Adds ERRORS_* ConfigDef definitions (errors.retry.timeout, errors.allowed.max, errors.log.enable ...) and accessors; the report says ConnectorConfig does not define these properties so getString throws ConfigException.
Adds DLQ_TOPIC_NAME_CONFIG = 'errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name' to the ConfigDef plus dlqTopicName(); this is the exact property the stack trace says is 'Unknown configuration'.

sinkTaskReporters changed from connConfig.getString(DeadLetterQueueReporter.PREFIX + '.' + DLQ_TOPIC_NAME) to connConfig.dlqTopicName() on a SinkConnectorConfig; this is the frame (Worker.sinkTaskReporters) where the exception surfaced, adapted to the new config.
Removes its private ConfigDef and DeadLetterQueueReporterConfig, takes SinkConnectorConfig instead; moves config ownership, forced by the config move.
ErrorReporter no longer extends Configurable; interface adaptation after the configure() methods were removed.
Drops its own ConfigDef/LogReporterConfig and reads connConfig.enableErrorLog(); relocation of config definitions.
Removes its own ConfigDef and takes retry/tolerance values by constructor from ConnectorConfig; relocation.
Replaces fromString with value(); small helper change to support the config definition in ConnectorConfig.

rationale: The DLQ topic property was read through a ConnectorConfig whose ConfigDef did not define it, so AbstractConfig.get threw. The fix defines the properties in ConnectorConfig and SinkConnectorConfig and rewires readers.
